screen.title: Conversation: Paying at the cafeteria
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a cafeteria cashier.

audio.text: Hi, can I pay with cash?
Sorry, we only take meal cards now. You can add money to your card at the machine by the door.
Oh, I didn't know that. Does the machine take cash?
Yes, cash or a bank card. It only takes a minute.
Great, thanks. I'll be right back.

options: He cannot pay with cash at the counter.
The machine by the door is broken.
The cafeteria is about to close.

why.en: Problem: the cafeteria only takes meal cards. A and C are not mentioned.
why.tr: Sorun: kafeterya yalnızca yemek kartı alıyor. A ve C söylenmiyor.

questions.stem: What will the man probably do next?
options: Go to the bank for cash
Put money on his meal card

why.en: Inference: he will use the machine and come right back.
why.tr: Çıkarım: makineyi kullanıp hemen geri dönecek.
